briefs.claim_en: Two crocodiles were seen in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru yesterday evening.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources confirm that crocodiles have been sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru on various occasions. The Hindu reported a giant crocodile sighting on March 26, 2010. News18 Kannada reported a sighting on September 7, 2023. The Star of Mysore reported a crocodile sighting on December 1, 2024, and another on January 28, 2026. Signboards around the lake warn people about the presence of crocodiles. However, none of the provided evidence reports a sighting of two crocodiles on October 7, 2026, as claimed.
gaps_en: No evidence found to corroborate the sighting of two crocodiles on October 7, 2026.
No official statement or news report specifically mentioning two crocodiles at any recent time.
